answer: Cosignatures are collected in mirror, verified in ledge, and knoll names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 29 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
